summary: A first-person narrator and her companion Arthur talk with Courtney, who is cheerfully devoted to her 'sister' Dawna, whom Courtney credits with rescuing her and giving her life meaning. The narrator challenges this, arguing that Dawna could have freed Courtney from the cartel herself and that Courtney is a pawn in Dawna's larger game. Courtney says Dawna's goal is to change the world by stopping cartels, cruelty, starvation and war, and that she intends to help.
one_line: In a cell-block conversation, Courtney describes her devotion to Dawna, who she says aims to change the world, while the narrator doubts Dawna's motives.
key_facts: The narrator is speaking with Courtney while they are held in cells, and Courtney says the cells are 'for your own good and all'.
Courtney says of Dawna: 'She's helping you' and 'She's amazing. The most amazing person in the world.'
Courtney says she 'was so lost before she helped me', referring to Dawna.
Courtney insists Dawna is her sister 'in every way that matters', though the narrator says she is not really her sister.
The narrator says Dawna could have walked into the cartel's compound and walked Courtney out of the cartel's custody, but did not.
Courtney says Dawna 'couldn't get me out of there herself', but came to get her 'as soon as she could' after the cartel snatched her.
The narrator tells Courtney that she is 'all' a pawn in some huge game Dawna is playing.
Courtney turns down the narrator's offer of help, saying Dawna is 'fixing everything' and that there will be no faraway island and no running away.
Courtney says her life is going to have 'Real meaning' by helping Dawna.
Asked what Dawna wants to do, Courtney answers 'Change the world.'
Courtney lists the world's problems as drug cartels, people doing cruel things to each other, people starving, and war.
Courtney says Dawna and everyone else are working to stop these horrors and 'doing so much good'.
The narrator reflects that Dawna could be a psychic, and ends by asking whether Dawna's goal is to make the world a better place.
